articles.title: Xi Jinping gets red carpet at Brics summit amid thaw in India-China relations
articles.highlight: 习近平在印度出席金砖峰会受到红毯欢迎，中印公开展示关系缓和，同时在美国主导地位动摇之际暗中争夺领导权。
articles.summary: 报道称，中国国家主席习近平抵达德里出席为期两天的金砖国家峰会，受到红毯、仪仗队和传统舞蹈表演的欢迎，随后将参加晚宴。此行被视为2020年边境冲突后两国走向和解的一步。值得注意的是，中印在公开展示缓和的同时，仍在美国全球主导地位动摇的背景下暗自争夺领导权，因此这则新闻适合用来观察大国关系的表里两面。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示是：外交场合的公开礼遇往往只是信号，不能等同于分歧解决；判断关系走向应同时看公开姿态与未摆上台面的竞争与利益交换。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Chinese president’s arrival in Delhi seen as step towards reconciliation after deadly 2020 military clash The Chinese president, Xi Jinping, has received a red-carpet welcome in India for a summit of Brics developing nations, as regional rivals Beijing and Delhi make a public display of thawing relations while quietly competing to lead at a time of shaky US global dominance. As Xi stepped off the plane, he was walked past an honour guard of Indian soldiers and traditional dancers in colourful dresses. Later on Saturday, he was due to attend a gala dinner for the two-day summit.

articles.title: The Day Dostoyevsky Discovered the Meaning of Life in a Dream
articles.highlight: “而它是如此简单……你会立刻发现该如何生活。”——这是陀思妥耶夫斯基在梦中得到的答案。
articles.summary: 《The Marginalian》记述了陀思妥耶夫斯基在梦中获得人生意义启示的那一天，那条启示被概括为：答案其实极其简单，简单到你会立刻明白该如何生活。这篇短文适合在忙碌间隙读一读，它提醒人：关于“怎么活”的答案未必复杂，可能只是一句被我们忽略的话。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发：真正改变人的答案往往简单到不像答案，难的是醒来之后仍照着它生活。
articles.sourceExcerpt: You will instantly find how to live."

articles.summary: 这是 Google 在 GitHub 上开源的项目（约 3364 stars），主打用自然语言驱动端到端的安卓自动化：它能跑通完整工作流、抓取日志，并可与 Antigravity、Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编程助手集成。值得关注是因为它把“让 AI 真正操作手机”这件事从演示推进到了可复用的工程组件，并给出了可量化的成功率指标。
articles.failureAnalysis: 最大风险是基准与现实的落差：AndroidWorld 是受控环境，而真机面临厂商 ROM 差异、权限弹窗、版本碎片化和应用反自动化机制，99% 的成功率很难直接迁移到线上。其次是成本与维护：逐步骤调用大模型既贵又慢，UI 一变就要重新适配，长期维护负担重。最后是分发与竞争：安卓生态的主导权在 Google 与手机厂商手里，系统级或厂商自带的自动化能力一旦成熟，第三方方案的生存空间会被大幅压缩。
articles.highlight: ARTEMIS 能把自然语言指令转化为可靠的安卓自动化，并在 AndroidWorld 基准测试中取得 99% 以上的成功率。

en.highlight: ARTEMIS turns natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation and achieves a 99%+ success rate on the AndroidWorld benchmark.
en.summary: This is a Google GitHub project (about 3,364 stars) that drives end-to-end Android automation from natural language: it runs full workflows, captures logs, and integrates with AI coding assistants such as Antigravity, Codex, and Claude Code. It is worth reading because it moves 'let AI actually operate a phone' from demo to reusable engineering component with a measurable success metric.
en.failureAnalysis: The key constraint is the gap between benchmark and reality: AndroidWorld is controlled, while real devices bring vendor ROM differences, permission dialogs, version fragmentation, and anti-automation defenses, so a 99% rate rarely transfers directly. On top of that, per-step LLM calls are costly and slow, and every UI change forces re-adaptation.
en.title: Google Artemis: Turning Natural-Language Instructions into Reliable Android Automation

articles.title: [AINews] DeepSeek v4.1-Flash: 763B-P8B-D16B novel causal Encoder–Decoder architecture with vision marks the Return of the Whale
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: Latent Space 的 AINews 条目介绍 DeepSeek v4.1-Flash：一个 763B 总参数、P8B、D16B 的全新因果编码器–解码器架构，并具备视觉能力，被形容为“鲸鱼归来”。已知的评论内容只有一句——同意 Sebastian 的观点，认为这次发布其实应该是 DeepSeek v5。值得关注的点在于：当一线工程圈认为一次发布“跳过了版本号”，通常意味着架构层面的变化比常规迭代更值得看。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点：版本号并不等于技术跃迁的幅度，从业者说“这该是 v5”时，指的往往是架构级的改变，而不是参数或跑分的例行上调。
articles.highlight: 我们同意 Sebastian 的看法：它的分量不该只叫 v4.1-Flash，而应该直接是 DeepSeek v5。
articles.sourceExcerpt: We agree with Sebastian: this should have been DeepSeek v5
